rasterize_pdf_to_png: rasterize a PDF file into PNG images saved to an output directory at a specified DPI
rasterize_pdf_return_pil: rasterize a PDF file and return PIL images as BytesIO objects instead of writing to disk
rasterize_pdf_specific_pages: rasterize specific pages of a PDF file by providing a list of page indices
run_rasterize_cli: run the CLI tool to rasterize multiple PDF files to PNG images with configurable DPI and page selection
rasterize_pdf_custom_dpi: rasterize a PDF file to PNG images at a custom DPI resolution for higher or lower quality output
